{{Quote|Certainly, m'lord. Yes, m'lord. As you say, m'lord.|A retainer to their liege|<ref name="RPG" />}}
A '''retainer''' was a personal servant, usually in the service of a member of the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]]. They were loyal servants to their lieges, and often overprotective about their [[Lord/Legends|lords]]. In some cases, the retainer's family had served the nobles of their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for generations. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as many nobles joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], they took their retainers into service with the Rebellion with them. In other instances, retainers were ordered into detached duty within the Alliance by their lords. However, the loyalty of the retainer was firmly with their liege above the Rebellion.<ref name="RPG" />

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fandar (pirate)|Fandar]], who was known as the "[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]]" had a number of loyal retainers.<ref name="Prince">{{WEGCite|story=The Pirate Prince (adventure)|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> The ruler of the [[Anointed People]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]], known as the [[Godking]], employed retainers as part of his personal retinue. Twenty-five of his retainers joined the Godking on a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] expedition he staged for visiting members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Rekara]] served as the retainer for [[Mors Odrion]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] dignitary.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The "Loyal Retainer" was one of the original twenty-four character templates used by the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', first published in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]]. If another player character was roleplaying as a noble, then it was suggested that the Loyal Retainer was in their service.<ref name="RPG" />
